title: How Austin ISD reached the edge of a state takeover
subtitle: Five straight failing ratings at one campus trigger mandatory action by the state education commissioner
alt: Timeline of the Austin ISD state takeover question: a 2015 Texas law making five straight F ratings trigger state action, the 2023 Houston ISD takeover, Webb and Burnet middle schools hitting a fifth failing rating in August 2026, the Nov. 3 school board election, and a TEA decision expected by the end of the year
source: The Texas Tribune and Austin Current

events.label: Texas law makes five straight Fs trigger state action
events.note: The commissioner must close the campus or replace the elected board

events.label: TEA replaces the Houston ISD board with appointees
events.note: Seven districts have had their leaders replaced since

events.label: Webb and Burnet hit a fifth straight failing rating
events.note: Austin ISD's own rating rose from a C to a B this month

events.label: 15 candidates run for five Austin ISD board seats
events.note: Four of the five seats up have no incumbent seeking re-election

next.label: Commissioner Mike Morath's decision is expected by the end of the year
